pages.text: $(bold)Ratio Technique$(): divide the enemy into ten, pierce the soul in one stroke. $(br2)$(bold)Forward activation (technique key C, requires a target in sight)$(): divide the target into ten equal parts and, at its seventh division, spawn a $(bold)golden weak-point orb$() — hovering 0.3 blocks in front of the target at 70% of its height, following along as the target moves or turns (lasts 20 seconds).

$(bold)Striking the weak point$(): only you can hit this orb — melee swings, arrows, and technique damage all work. A hit resolves one critical strike against the target: damage × crit multiplier = 1.3 + Output×0.08 + Affinity×0.004 (about ×2.5 at a full build); the weak point shatters in a single hit. No weak-point hit, no critical — that is what true precision demands. $(br2)Pressing the technique key again on a target that already bears a weak point instantly triggers one $(bold)precision slash$() (guaranteed weak-point strike): damage = shared cursed technique base × crit multiplier. $(br2)The orb follows the target around — do not rush to cut the body; aim for that golden speck first.
